findings.ref: #header-search
findings.message: The placeholder "Search for waterproof shoes..." has a contrast of 2.35:1 with the field (#00568080 on #e6eef2). Placeholder text is text, and WCAG 1.4.3 asks for 4.5:1.
findings.subject: Search for waterproof shoes...
findings.html: <input id="header-search" class="search__input w-full input js-search-input" type="search" role="combobox" name="q" placeholder="Search for sun hats" autocomplete="off">

findings.ref: #header-search
findings.message: The browser exposes this element as a combobox but computes no name for it: a screen reader announces only "combobox", not what it is for. Give it a name (visible text, aria-labelledby or aria-label).
findings.subject: combobox
findings.html: <input id="header-search" class="search__input w-full input js-search-input" type="search" role="combobox" name="q" placeholder="Search for sun hats" autocomplete="off">
